summary: Blue Acquisition Corp/Cayman, a Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a Sixth Amendment to its November 19, 2025 Business Combination Agreement with Blockfusion Digital Infrastructure (Pubco) and Blockfusion USA, Inc. The amendment raises the maximum earnout to 15,000,000 Pubco Class A shares, vesting in thirds at 20-of-30-day VWAP thresholds of $13.00, $15.00 and $17.00, and excludes Blockfusion's September 4, 2026 Series A warrant issued to CoreWeave from certain calculations. No price per share, premium, close date or advisor was stated. Watch dilution from earnouts and CoreWeave's warrant stake, amendment frequency and redemption risk ahead of closing.
